metadata.overview: Monitors and controls miners running Luxor's LuxOS firmware through the LuxOS TCP API on port 4028. Compatibility follows the firmware, not the hardware model: any miner running LuxOS answers the same API. The API has no authentication, so keep miners on a trusted network. Writes use a LuxOS session and never take over a session held by someone else. Operations affect physical hardware — prioritize thermal safety.

telemetry.name: hashrate_rt
telemetry.description: Hashrate over the last 5 seconds (summary GHS 5s).

telemetry.name: hashrate_avg
telemetry.description: Average hashrate since the miner application started (summary GHS av).

telemetry.name: hashrate_ideal
telemetry.description: Sum of the hashboards' nominal hashrate. A persistent gap versus hashrate_rt indicates degraded or throttled hashboards.

telemetry.name: power
telemetry.description: Power draw in watts. Measured by newer PSUs (APW17, 3-phase APW11) and estimated for older ones.

telemetry.name: efficiency
telemetry.description: Power divided by the 30-minute hashrate. null while the miner is not hashing.

telemetry.name: temperature
telemetry.description: Highest hashboard temperature. null when no board reports a temperature.

telemetry.name: fans
telemetry.description: Fans as { index, rpm, speed_pct, connector }. Empty on hydro and immersion machines, which have no fans. A fan at 0 RPM on a running air-cooled miner is a mechanical failure.

telemetry.name: status
telemetry.description: error when LuxOS reports an active event, sleeping when curtailed, otherwise mining or not_mining from the 5-second hashrate.

telemetry.name: uptime
telemetry.description: Seconds since the miner application started.

telemetry.name: power_mode
telemetry.description: normal, or sleep while the miner is curtailed.

telemetry.name: profile
telemetry.description: Name of the active LuxOS performance profile.

telemetry.name: accepted_shares
telemetry.description: Accepted shares since the miner application started.

telemetry.name: rejected_shares
telemetry.description: Rejected, non-stale shares since the miner application started. A rising count indicates pool or network problems.

telemetry.name: pool_url
telemetry.description: URL of the first alive pool, or the first configured pool when none is alive.

telemetry.name: pools
telemetry.description: Configured pools in priority order with status and share counters. Pool passwords are never included.

telemetry.name: hashboards
telemetry.description: Per-board status, profile, real/average/nominal hashrate, temperature, labeled sensor readings, hardware errors and serial number.

telemetry.name: errors
telemetry.description: Active LuxOS events, each with code, description, target and doc URL. An empty array means no active event.

telemetry.name: device_info
telemetry.description: Model, serial number, MAC, IP, hostname, control board, cooling type, PSU and nameplate hashrate.

telemetry.name: firmware_info
telemetry.description: LuxOS version, API version and compile time.

telemetry.name: snap
telemetry.description: Full snapshot of stats and config. A failed source shows { error } in its place.

commands.name: reboot
commands.description: Reboots the miner. Several minutes of downtime. 5-minute cooldown, consumed by every attempt. Never retry automatically.

commands.name: setLED

params.name: enabled
params.description: true blinks the red LED to locate the miner; false returns it to automatic mode.

commands.description: Turns the locate LED on or off.

commands.name: setPowerMode

params.name: mode
params.description: sleep curtails the miner (hashboards and PSU off); normal wakes it up.

commands.description: Curtails or wakes up the miner. A sleeping miner stays asleep across reboots until woken up.

commands.name: setProfile

params.name: profile
params.description: Name of an existing profile, as listed by the profiles API. LuxOS names use letters, digits, '_', '-', '+', '.' and spaces.

commands.description: Applies a LuxOS performance profile to all hashboards. The boards ramp to the new frequency and voltage.

commands.name: setupPools

params.name: pools
params.description: Array of 1-3 entries of { url, user, password } (or worker_name, worker_password). Values must not contain commas.

commands.description: Replaces the pool list: adds the new pools, then removes the old ones.

troubleshooting: If alert.overheat, check fan speeds, the errors channel and the inlet temperature. Do not raise the profile until resolved.
If alert.fan_failure, a fan at 0 RPM on a running air-cooled miner is a mechanical failure.
If alert.hashrate_low, the miner may be ramping after a reboot, profile change or wake-up — wait 15 minutes before acting.
If alert.hashboard_error persists after a reboot, read the errors channel and escalate to an operator.
If alert.pool_dead, check the pool URLs and network path; all pools Dead means the miner is mining nothing.
If a write fails with ERR_SESSION_BUSY, someone else is changing the miner. Wait; never force their session off.
If status is OFFLINE, do not attempt reboot. Escalate to an operator.

errors.ERR_DEVICE_CONFIG_INVALID: The device config is missing an address or has an invalid port or timeout.
errors.ERR_TCP_TIMEOUT: The miner did not answer within the timeout. For writes the physical outcome is unknown — never retry automatically.
errors.ERR_TCP_CONNECTION: The TCP connection failed or was reset. For writes the physical outcome is unknown — never retry automatically.
errors.ERR_API_RESPONSE_INVALID: The miner returned a non-JSON answer or a section without an expected field.
errors.ERR_API_STATUS_ERROR: LuxOS answered STATUS E for the command. The message carries the firmware's reason.
errors.ERR_SESSION_BUSY: Another tool or operator holds the LuxOS session. The worker never kills it; retry after that session ends.
errors.ERR_COMMAND_FAILED: The command failed without a more specific error code.
errors.ERR_COMMAND_COOLDOWN: The command was issued before its cooldown elapsed.
errors.ERR_COMMAND_IN_PROGRESS: A command of this type is already running for the device.
errors.ERR_SET_LED_ENABLED_INVALID: The setLED enabled parameter is not a boolean.
errors.ERR_SET_POWER_MODE_INVALID: The power mode is not normal or sleep.
errors.ERR_SET_PROFILE_INVALID: The profile name is missing or is not a valid LuxOS profile name (letters, digits, '_', '-', '+', '.' and spaces, starting and ending with a letter or digit).
errors.ERR_PROFILE_UNKNOWN: The miner has no profile with that name.
errors.ERR_POOLS_INVALID: The pool list must contain 1-3 entries, each with a stratum url and a user, and no commas.
errors.ERR_POOLS_PARTIAL: The pool change stopped part way. The message says which pools are in place; check the pools telemetry before acting again.
errors.ERR_POOLS_GROUPS_UNSUPPORTED: The miner has pools in more than one LuxOS pool group. setupPools only replaces a single-group pool list; change multi-group setups by hand.
